create_boxoban_instance: create a Boxoban instance to load and cache Boxoban puzzle levels from a dataset
generate_random_levels: use boxoban_level_generator to yield random Boxoban levels from the unfiltered valid set
download_and_cache_levels: call get_data on a Boxoban instance to download extract and cache levels as npz
access_loaded_levels: access the levels attribute on a Boxoban instance to get the numpy array of level strings
check_num_levels: check the num_levels attribute on a Boxoban instance to get the total number of loaded levels
